chunks: Ibn al-Walid, from al-Saffar, from Ibn Hashim, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I said: 'The Fitra of Allah which He created the people upon'? He said: 'Tawhid.'
ai.seo_question: What is the Fitra of Allah according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the innate disposition (Fitra) is explicitly defined as Tawhid, establishing monotheism not merely as a theological doctrine but as the primordial essence of human nature. This aligns with the Shia scholarly view that the soul's natural inclination is toward divine unity, which may be obscured by societal influences but remains the core of human identity. The hadith underscores the continuity between creation and recognition of God, framing faith as a return to one's original state.

en.ammaar-muslim: 2. [2/380] al-Tawhid: Ibn al-Walid from al-Saffar from Ibn Hashim from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham b. Salim from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام. He (Hisham) said:
I said: “The Fitra of Allah which He created the people upon” [30:30]? He (the Imam) said: (that is) Tawhid.
